item.name: Update a client's own business profile fields

request.name: Update a client's own business profile fields

description.content:
Only `name`, `contactName`, `email`, `phone`, and `address` can be
set — see ClientPatchRequest. The request body must contain at
least one of these fields and no others; any unknown or
forbidden field (including `id`, `organizationId`, `stage`,
`source`, `ownerName`, `notes`, `archivedAt`, `createdAt`)
rejects the ENTIRE request with 400, none of it is silently
applied or dropped. An empty body is also rejected. Same
identical-404 behavior as GET for a cross-organization or
archived id — a failed write never distinguishes "not found"
from "not yours".

response.name: The updated client.

item.name: Create a staff to-do tied to a client

request.name: Create a staff to-do tied to a client

description.content:
`clientId` must reference a client belonging to the authenticated
organization (verified with the exact same rule as GET/PATCH
/clients) — otherwise the request fails with a generic
VALIDATION_ERROR that never distinguishes "no such client" from
"not yours". Only TaskCreateRequest's fields are accepted;
`assignee` (which PUBLIC-MAP staff member owns the task) can
never be set through this API. Supports `Idempotency-Key" — see
the IdempotencyKey parameter.

header.description:
Optional but strongly recommended for write routes. A retry with
the same key and the same request body returns the original
resource unchanged (status 201, identical body) instead of
creating a duplicate. Reusing the same key with a different body
is rejected with 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT. Scoped per
integration and per route — the same key string used on two
different write routes does not collide.

response.name: The created task (or the original one, if this is a valid Idempotency-Key replay).

description.content:
Public REST API for PUBLIC-MAP — consumable by n8n, Make, Zapier,
Airtable, custom applications, or any standard HTTP client.

This is a first-draft specification covering the routes shipped so
far: read-only audits/reports, clients (read + a whitelisted partial
update), and creating tasks/interactions (with Idempotency-Key
support). It is not yet exposed through a public Swagger/Redoc portal
— see lib/api-v1/SECURITY.md for the security model this spec assumes
(key format, scope model, error envelope).

Every response — success or error — carries rate-limit/quota headers
(`X-RateLimit-*`, `X-Quota-*`, see the RateLimitHeaders/QuotaHeaders
components). A per-API-key requests-per-minute budget and a per-
organization requests-per-day quota (driven by the organization's
subscription plan, defaulting to a limited Free tier with no active
subscription) are both enforced on every request; exceeding either
returns 429 with a `Retry-After` header — see the RateLimited
response component and lib/api-v1/SECURITY.md.
